subject: SIG: SCIM/SSO provisioning evidence + MFA enforcement timeline
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Janet Lowe <janet.lowe@fintech.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: SCIM/SSO provisioning evidence + MFA enforcement timeline

Hi Janet—

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Per our conversation, attaching our current evidence artifacts and a short plan for the MFA enforcement window you asked about. High level:

- SCIM: we can share a full SCIM export (roles + group mappings) for the last 30 days; see attached scim-config-export.csv.
- SSO/SAML: metadata and assertion examples are available; I included a short doc with sample SAML responses in the shared drive link below.
- MFA: we require MFA for all console logins today; for service accounts we recommend rotating to key-based and limiting scopes.

Requested next steps for us:
1) Confirm the exact list of user IDs you want in the SCIM export (we pulled active users in prod by default).
2) Do you need signed SAML assertions or are unsigned examples fine for the SIG?
3) Would you like us to propose a firm two-week MFA enforcement window for end users, or prefer a phased schedule by team?

I'll loop Marcus and Sergio for technical verification and timelines.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-config-export.csv (CSV), sig_answers_sso_mfa.docx (DOCX)

From: Janet Lowe <janet.lowe@fintech.co>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: FintechCo Security <security@fintech.co>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG: SCIM/SSO provisioning evidence + MFA enforcement timeline

Camila,

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications:

- For the SCIM export please include both active and suspended accounts for the last 90 days (we want to validate provisioning/deprovisioning).
- We will need examples of signed SAML assertions used in a successful login (redacted PII is OK).
- For MFA, we prefer a phased rollout: start with admin/dev teams for a one-week pilot, then org-wide enforcement two weeks later. Can you draft dates?

Also, can you confirm whether RBAC role assignments are in SCIM group attributes or maintained separately inside Redwood Console? That will affect our mapping doc.

Best,
Janet
Janet Lowe
Security Operations, FintechCo
janet.lowe@fintech.co

Camila / Sergio—

Quick technical notes and an internal checklist for the export and pilot. See inline: 

- SCIM scope: we can produce a 90-day export including suspended accounts; exported attributes will include: userName, externalId, active, groups, roles, emails, lastLogin. I'm attaching a sanitized CSV sample.
- RBAC mapping: role assignments are represented in two places — primary role is in the Console role inventory (DB-backed) and we push group -> role mappings into SCIM group attributes for customers who enable group sync. For FintechCo we currently have group sync enabled for engineering and ops groups.
- SAML assertions: we can generate signed examples using our test IdP signing key; prod-signed assertions require an access request (we can provide redacted production assertions under NDA).
- MFA plan: propose pilot dates: Admin/dev pilot: Sep 29–Oct 3 (one week). Org-wide enforcement: Oct 17–Oct 31 (two-week window with weekend blackout). We'll publish a runbook and a crosswalk mapping SCIM group -> Console role.

Action items (internal):
- Camila: confirm SCIM ID list to include in export and permission to share signed test assertions with FintechCo.
- Sergio: prepare sanitized CSV and the mfa-rollout-slides.pdf for the pilot comms.
- Marcus: prepare an internal runbook and a short RBAC mapping table (CSV).

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
